title: Used to / Be Used to
description: Past habits vs. being accustomed to something
examples: My mother is used to cooking on Friday.
I didn't use to watch this much TV.
You will be used to noisy children.
Tala used to be my best friend.
I used to drink a glass of red Vimto every day.
I was used to seeing sunshine on Half-moon beach.
Are you used to eating spicy food?
My brother is used to getting up early for school.
Did you use to eat Kabsa?
